a significant number of thermal proteins of modern Nelumbo are conserved from the archaean, and that the thermal proteins of long-living Nelumbo are highly stable and functionally competent.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the genome of Nelumbo contains a set of thermal-stable genes that may have evolved from ancient ancestors of archaean hyperthermophiles.
